query: For my 57-year-old female: among women aged 52–62 with AKI, what is the per-encounter standard deviation of 30-day readmission?
final_sql: SELECT stddev(days_to_readmission) AS standard_deviation FROM (SELECT (admittime - lag(dischtime) OVER (PARTITION BY subject_id ORDER BY admittime))/30 AS days_to_readmission FROM admissions JOIN patients ON admissions.subject_id = patients.subject_id WHERE gender = 'F' AND age(CURRENT_DATE, date_trunc('year', birthdate)) = 57 AND age(CURRENT_DATE, date_trunc('year', admitdate)) BETWEEN 52 AND 62 AND readmission = 'Y' ) AS subquery;
